overview.purpose: A Spring Boot sample REST API that exposes the MySQL Sakila DVD-rental database for learning and testing.
functionality: CRUD access to actors, customers, films, payments, rentals, staff, and stores
Report endpoints for more complex queries
Generated REST Docs, OpenAPI/Swagger specification, and Postman collection
overview.architecture: Layered Spring Boot application using Spring Web, Spring Data JPA, HATEOAS, validation, security, Querydsl/Blaze-Persistence for query construction, MapStruct for mapping, MySQL persistence, and Actuator/Micrometer for observability.
overview.data_flow: HTTP request -> Spring web/controller layer -> application/service and query layer -> JPA/Querydsl persistence -> MySQL Sakila database -> mapped/HATEOAS response.
noteworthy_aspects: Documentation artifacts are generated from tests using Spring REST Docs
Build also generates OpenAPI and Postman artifacts
risks_and_limitations: This bootstrap JSON does not claim method-level coverage; execute the analyzer for exact methods and measured complexity.
Runtime behavior depends on external database configuration and seeded Sakila data.
